_notes: Floor plan: corner store with WALL UNITS 1-19 wrapping perimeter, two MK gondolas + cash counter in upper-centre, two makeup vanity units on the right, and storefront glazing at the bottom (entrance in middle).

Camera mapping (from frame inspection): entry 1.mp4 = CAM_ENTRY_01 (front door, glass storefront); entry 2.mp4 = CAM_ENTRY_02 (same camera, different day's footage); zone.mp4 = CAM_ZONE_03 (skincare wall corner where two perpendicular walls meet); billing_area.mp4 = CAM_BILLING_06 (cash counter + makeup vanity).
Polygons are NORMALISED image coordinates [0..1]. Each entry camera has an entry line near the top of the frame (door is at top, store interior is below).

CAM_ENTRY_01.description: Front entrance, glass storefront at top of frame; store interior is below. User-supplied entry-gate quadrilateral (960x1080 px): A(348,676) B(637,618) C(709,849) D(333,902). Side AB is the door threshold (outer edge); CD is the inner edge on the wood floor. Inbound normal points downward into the store.

CAM_ENTRY_02.description: Front entrance (different day's footage from same camera position). Same gate polygon as CAM_ENTRY_01.

CAM_ZONE_03.description: Skincare wall corner: two perpendicular wall sections meet near the top-centre. Left wall holds Pilgrim/Good Vibes brands, right wall holds De-Tan/Dermaco/Minimalist/Aqualogica.

CAM_BILLING_06.description: Cash counter island in middle of frame (960x1080). Polygons (corrected after frame review): BILLING_COUNTER = white POS-counter footprint (330,530)-(697,538)-(706,839)-(324,852); BILLING_STAFF_SIDE = strip at the bottom of the frame where staff operate the POS / scanner; BILLING = customer queue strip on the FAR side of the counter (top of frame) where shoppers approach to pay.
